title: Confirm dialogs: Alert.alert sites hard-code 取消/刪除/移除/失敗 and post-delete copy; no confirm() helper mirroring useConfirm
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/ui/confirm-provider.tsx:386-445 (confirm({title,message,confirmText,cancelText,danger}) → Promise<boolean>; ghost cancel + primary or danger confirm); call sites e.g. apps/web/src/app/app/feed/page.tsx:76-81 (title Common.delete, confirm Common.delete, cancel Common.cancel)
ios_ref: apps/ios/app/family.tsx:89,99,114,124,140,151,311 ('取消', '失敗', '無法…'); apps/ios/app/friends/index.tsx:105,111-115,124,132 ('取消', '移除', '失敗'); apps/ios/src/components/feed/post-card.tsx:71-83 ('刪除貼文', '確定要刪除…', '取消', '刪除', '刪除失敗'); apps/ios/src/components/feed/post-menu.tsx:83 ('取消'); apps/ios/src/components/settings/family-section.tsx:96,120,146,304 ('失敗', '無法…')
current_ios: Using the native Alert as the confirm surface is an acceptable iOS equivalent, and every danger confirm already uses style:'destructive'. The copy is inconsistent, though: about 20 hard-coded Chinese strings, and title and message semantics differ from web.
target: A promise-based confirm() with web's API and i18n defaults, so every confirm reads the same as web in both locales.
fix_plan: Create apps/ios/src/lib/confirm.ts: export function confirm({ title, message, confirmText = t('Common.confirm'), cancelText = t('Common.cancel'), danger }): Promise<boolean>. Implement it with Alert.alert(title ?? t('Common.confirm'), message, [{ text: cancelText, style: 'cancel', onPress: () => resolve(false) }, { text: confirmText, style: danger ? 'destructive' : 'default', onPress: () => resolve(true) }], { cancelable: true, onDismiss: () => resolve(false) }). Also export notifyError(msg?) as Alert.alert(t('Error.title'), msg). Migrate the call sites above. Post delete: title Common.delete, message = the first 80 chars of the post text, confirm Common.delete. Friend remove: confirm Common.delete or Friends.removeConfirm. Replace each '失敗' with t('Error.title').

title: Button primitive: default radius 14 matches neither web nor the design-system SoT; icon is wrapped in <Text>; press scale 0.99 vs SoT .97
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/ui/button.tsx:26-30 (rounded-lg = Tailwind 8px today); docs/design-system.md §4 (buttons = pill radius, active:scale-[.97])
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/components/ui/Button.tsx:139 (br = pill ? radius.pill : radius.lg), 147 (icon rendered inside <Text>), 220 (scale 0.99)
current_ios: Non-pill buttons use 14pt corners. Passing a lucide element as the icon nests an SVG view inside Text, so the colour is not applied and baseline layout is quirky. The press feedback is weaker than the SoT.
target: Default to the SoT pill radius, keeping an opt-out prop `radius`. Render the icon in a View, not Text; callers pass the colour, or Button clones the element with color=v.fg. Pressed scale 0.97, skipped when useReducedMotion() returns true.
fix_plan: In Button.tsx, change `pill = false` to `pill = true`, or add `shape: 'pill' | 'rounded'` defaulting to pill. Change line 147 to `<View>{isValidElement(icon) ? cloneElement(icon, { color: v.fg }) : <Text ...>{icon}</Text>}</View>`. Set pressed to transform scale 0.97, applied only when the motion hook allows it.

title: ui Button primitive (prerequisite for most SOCIAL fixes): icon slot is wrapped in <Text> and horizontal padding is a fixed 24 for every size
current_ios: apps/ios/src/components/ui/Button.tsx:70 renders `<Text style={[styles.icon,{color:v.fg}]}>{icon}</Text>`, so a lucide SVG becomes an inline view inside Text. That gives baseline misalignment, and Text colour does not reach the SVG. No caller in apps/ios currently passes `icon`, so the path is untested. styles.base uses paddingHorizontal spacing.xl (24) for sm/md/lg, while web SIZES are sm px-3 / md px-4 / lg px-6 (button.tsx:27-31). sm minHeight is 36 vs web h-8 (keeping 36 as the native floor is fine). SOCIAL-6/8/10/11/12/15 all pass lucide icons via `icon` and use sm buttons in rows.
target: Icon rendered as a sibling View inside the row (gap 8), with per-size padding matching web: sm 12, md 16, lg 24.
fix_plan: In Button.tsx, replace the icon Text wrapper with `{icon != null ? (typeof icon === 'string' ? <Text style={[styles.icon,{color:v.fg}]}>{icon}</Text> : <View style={styles.iconBox}>{icon}</View>) : null}`, where iconBox is {alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'}. Add `const PADX: Record<ButtonSize, number> = { sm: 12, md: 16, lg: 24 }` and apply `paddingHorizontal: PADX[size]` alongside minHeight. Callers pass lucide icons with an explicit color (#fff for primary, colors.ink for secondary), because lucide-react-native does not inherit Text colour. Check existing callers (family.tsx, dog-leaderboard.tsx, human-leaderboard.tsx, family-section.tsx, EmptyState) for width regressions from the smaller md padding.
